Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.af: Aanbeveel: stel 'n pasgemaakte CPC-begroting as jy handmatige beheer oor besteding en bod wil hê.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.zu: Kunconyiwe: setha ibhajethi ye-CPC yangokwezifiso uma ufuna ukulawula okwenziwa ngesandla phezu kwezindleko namabhidi.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.xh: Kuyacetyiswa: seta uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwe-CPC ukuba ufuna ulawulo lwezandla kwinkcitho kunye neebhidi.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.st: E khothalelitsoe: beha tekanyetso ea CPC e tloaelehileng haeba u batla ho laola tšebeliso ea chelete le litefiso.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.nso: E kgothaletšwa: beakanya tekanyetšo ya CPC ya tlwaelo ge o nyaka taolo ya seatla godimo ga tšhomišo ya tšhelete le dipeeletšo.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.tn: E kgothaletswa: seta tekanyetsokabo ya CPC e e tlwaelegileng fa e le gore o batla taolo ya diatla ya tiriso ya madi le dikopo.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.ts: Swi ringanyetiwa: veka mpimanyeto wa CPC wa ntolovelo loko u lava vulawuri bya mavoko eka matirhiselo ya mali na tibidhi.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.ve: Zwo themendelwa: vheani mugaganyagwama wa CPC wo khetheaho arali ni tshi ṱoḓa ndaulo ya zwanḓa kha u shumisa masheleni na u ṋetshedza.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.ss: Kunconyiwe: setha isabelomali se-CPC ngekwemkhuba uma ufuna kulawula ngesandla ngetulu kwekucitsa imali kanye nemabhidi.

Repeating visits must use a saved client.af: Herhaalde besoeke moet 'n gestoorde kliënt gebruik. Kies eers die kliënt uit soekresultate.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.zu: Ukuvakasha okuphindayo kufanele kusebenzise iklayenti elilondoloziwe. Khetha iklayenti emiphumeleni yosesho kuqala.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.xh: Utyelelo oluphindaphindiweyo kufuneka lusebenzise umxhasi ogciniweyo. Khetha umxhasi kwiziphumo zophendlo kuqala.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.st: Maeto a pheta-phetoang a tlameha ho sebelisa moreki ea bolokiloeng. Khetha moreki ho tsoa liphethong tsa lipatlisiso pele.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.nso: Diketelo tše di boeletšago di swanetše go šomiša moreki yo a bolokilwego. Kgetha moreki go tšwa go dipoelo tša nyakišišo pele.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.tn: Diketelo tse di boaboelediwang di tshwanetse go dirisa tlelaente e e bolokilweng. Tlhopha tlelaente mo dipholong tsa patlo pele.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.ts: Ku endzela loku phindha-phindhiweke ku fanele ku tirhisa xitirhisiwa lexi hlayisiweke. Hlawula xitirhisiwa eka mimbuyelo ya ku lavisisa ku sungula.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.ve: U dovholola madalo zwi fanela u shumisa client yo vhulungwaho. Khethani khasiṱama kha mvelelo dza ṱhoḓisiso u thoma.
Repeating visits must use a saved client.ss: Kuvakashela lokuphindzaphindziwe kumele kusebentise iklayenti leligciniwe. Khetsa iklayenti kusuka emiphumeleni yeluphenyo kucala.

Recurring bookings need a saved client p.af: Herhalende besprekings benodig 'n gestoorde kliëntprofiel sodat toekomstige besoeke veilig bestuur kan word.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.zu: Ukubhukha okuphindelelayo kudinga iphrofayela yeklayenti elondoloziwe ukuze ukuvakasha kwesikhathi esizayo kulawulwe ngokuphepha.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.xh: Ukubhukisha rhoqo kufuna iprofayile yomthengi egciniweyo ukuze utyelelo lwexesha elizayo lube nokulawulwa ngokukhuselekileyo.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.st: Lipehelo tse etsahalang khafetsa li hloka profaele ea bareki e bolokiloeng e le hore maeto a kamoso a tle a laolehe ka mokhoa o sireletsehileng.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.nso: Dipeeletšo tše di ipoeletšago di nyaka profaele ya moreki ye e bolokilwego gore diketelo tša ka moso di kgone go laolwa ka polokego.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.tn: Dipeeletso tse di ipoeletsang di tlhoka porofaele ya tlelaente e e bolokilweng gore maeto a mo isagweng a kgone go laolwa ka pabalesego.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.ts: Ku bukuta loku vuyeleriwaka ku lava phurofayili ya tiklayenti leyi hlayisiweke leswaku maendzo ya nkarhi lowu taka ya ta lawuriwa hi ku hlayiseka.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.ve: U buka zwine zwa dzulela u itea zwi ṱoḓa phrofaili ya khasiṱama yo vhulungwaho u itela uri madalo a tshifhinga tshi ḓaho a kone u langiwa nga nḓila yo tsireledzeaho.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.ss: Kubhukha lokuphindzaphindvwako kudzinga iphrofayli yeklayenti legciniwe kute kuvakashela esikhatsini lesitako kulawulwe ngendlela lephephile.

Using platform defaults for upselling. S.st: Ho sebelisa li-platform tsa kamehla bakeng sa ho rekisa. Boloka ho ipehela khetho ea hau sesebelisoa sena.

Using platform defaults for upselling. S.tn: Go dirisa ditlhomamiso tsa polatefomo go rekisa. Boloka go seta kgetho ya gago mo sedirisweng seno.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.ts: Ku tirhisa ti platform defaults eka upselling. Hlayisa ku veka ku tsakela ka wena eka xitirhisiwa lexi.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.ve: U shumisa zwithu zwa pulatifomo zwa u rengisa. Vhulungani u itela u setha zwine na zwi takalela kha tshishumiswa itshi.

Complete bookings and collect reviews to.st: Tlatsa lipehelo 'me u bokelle maikutlo ho fumana lintlha. Mohato oa hau o latelang ke {{name}}.

Complete bookings and collect reviews to.ve: U fhedza u buka na u kuvhanganya dzi review u itela u wana points. Tshipikwa tshaṋu tshi tevhelaho ndi {{name}}.
Complete bookings and collect reviews to.ss: Gcwalisa kubhuka bese uhlanganisa kubuyeketwa kute utfole emaphuzu. Lizinga lakho lelilandzelako ngu {{name}}.

Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.af: Virtuele betaalpunt skep betaalskakels en QR-kodes sonder 'n fisiese terminaal.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.zu: Ukukhokha okubonakalayo kudala izixhumanisi zokukhokha ezisingathiwe namakhodi e-QR ngaphandle kwetheminali ebonakalayo.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.xh: Ukuphuma okubonakalayo kwenza amakhonkco entlawulo ebanjwe kunye neekhowudi ze-QR ngaphandle kwe-terminal ebonakalayo.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.st: Virtual Checkout e theha lihokelo tsa ho lefa tse tsamaisoang le likhoutu tsa QR ntle le terminal ea 'mele.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.nso: Virtual checkout bopa hosted tefo dikgokelo le QR dikhoutu ntle le terminal 'mele.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.tn: Go reka ka khomphiutha go dira dikgokagano tsa tuelo tse di amogetsweng le dikhoutu tsa QR kwantle ga theminale ya mmatota.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.ts: Virtual checkout yi tumbuluxa swihlanganisi swa hakelo leswi khomiweke na tikhodi ta QR handle ka theminali ya xiviri.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.ve: U bvisa ha vhukuma zwi sika vhuṱumani ha mbadelo ho ṱanganedzwaho na khoudu dza QR hu si na theminala ya vhukuma.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.ss: Kukhipha imali nge-inthanethi kwenta tikhonjiso tekukhokha letisingatsiwe kanye nemakhodi e-QR ngaphandle kwetheminali lebonakalako.

Your terminal order payment was confirme.xh: Intlawulo ye-odolo ye-terminal yakho iqinisekisiwe. Buyela kwivenkile yeTheminali ukuze ulandelele iodolo yakho.
Your terminal order payment was confirme.st: Tefo ea odara ea hau e netefalitsoe. Khutlela ho Terminal shop ho latela odara ea hau.
Your terminal order payment was confirme.nso: Tefo ya gago ya otara ya terminal e ile ya tiišetšwa. Boela lebenkeleng la Terminal go latela otara ya gago.
Your terminal order payment was confirme.tn: Tuelo ya otara ya gago ya theminale e netefaditswe. Boela kwa lebentleleng la Terminal go latedisa otara ya gago.

A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.af: 'n Nutsrekening, bankstaat of huurkontrak met jou naam daarop, nie ouer as 3 maande nie.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.zu: Ibhili yensiza, isitatimende sasebhange, noma indawo yokuqashisa enegama lakho kuyo, engekho ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezi-3.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.xh: Ityala elisetyenziswayo, isitatimenti sebhanki, okanye irenti enegama lakho kuyo, hayi ngaphezulu kweenyanga ezi-3.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.st: Tefiso ea tšebeliso ea chelete, setatemente sa banka, kapa khiriso e nang le lebitso la hau ho eona, e sa feteng likhoeli tse 3.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.nso: Tefo ya ditirelo, setatamente sa panka, goba khiro yeo e nago le leina la gago, yeo e sego ya kgale go feta dikgwedi tše 3.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.tn: Sekoloto sa ditirelo, setatamente sa banka, kgotsa khiro e e nang le leina la gago mo go yone, e e seng ya bogologolo go feta dikgwedi di le 3.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.ts: Xibalo xa vukorhokeri, xitatimende xa le bangi, kumbe lease leyi nga na vito ra wena, leyi nga riki ya khale ku tlula 3 wa tinhweti.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.ve: Bili ya utility, tshitatamennde tsha bannga, kana lease ine ya vha na dzina lavho khayo, i si ya kale u fhira minwedzi ya 3.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.ss: Ibhili yetinsita, sitatimende sasebhange, noma i-lease leneligama lakho, lengakapheli tinyanga letingu-3.
